summary: Backend 31/31 passed (pre-existing suite, unchanged in this change set). Browser: 7/7 passed - new QuickFind typeahead/recents/scan checks plus re-ran the existing finds-filters-and-legacy-inventory-route check unchanged.

checks.criterion: Legacy /inventory scan still works after the shared-resolver refactor (GET /api/inventory/lookup 200/404)
checks.name: test_tscheck_scan_sku_lookup.py::test_lookup_unknown_sku_returns_404 / test_lookup_known_sku_returns_200_and_matches_created_item
checks.evidence: Pre-existing test file re-run: GET /api/inventory/lookup?sku=000000000000 -> 404; created tscheck-lookup-item then GET /api/inventory/lookup?sku=<its sku> -> 200 with matching id/title. Full suite 31/31 passed in 27.36s, confirming shared resolveScannedCode plumbing didn't break this endpoint.

checks.criterion: Typeahead suggestions on the Finds search box
checks.name: quickfind-typeahead-suggestions
checks.evidence: Manager sign-in -> /finds -> typed 'jacket' into finds-search -> finds-suggestions visible with 1-6 [role=option] rows; first row text contains the title, 'SKU' + brand, and a £-formatted price.

checks.criterion: Tap a suggestion jumps straight to the item's price tag
checks.name: quickfind-suggestion-tap-navigates-to-tag
checks.evidence: Clicked finds-suggestion-{id} for the first 'jacket' match -> URL became /tag/{that same id} -> tag-price visible. No intermediate grid scroll/navigation.

checks.name: quickfind-keyboard-navigation
checks.evidence: Two ArrowDown presses highlighted option index 1 (aria-selected=true), one ArrowUp moved highlight back to index 0; Escape closed finds-suggestions and stayed on /finds (no navigation) - note: Escape also natively clears a type=search input in Chromium, so the query was re-typed before the final step; Enter with option index 1 highlighted navigated to that option's /tag/{id} with tag-price visible.

checks.criterion: Recently opened items show when the box is empty
checks.name: quickfind-recent-items-shown-when-empty
checks.evidence: Opened a 'jacket' suggestion (seeding localStorage 'recent-items' in-context), returned to /finds, focused the empty finds-search -> finds-suggestions-recent-label ('Recently opened') visible plus 1-4 option rows including the just-viewed item's finds-suggestion-{id}; typing 'jacket' afterward hid the recent label, confirming matches replace recents.

checks.name: quickfind-scan-button-manual-sku
checks.evidence: finds-scan-button opened scanner-dialog ('Scan a price tag'); manual SKU '000000' -> 'No item matches that barcode' toast, dialog stayed open, URL stayed /finds (the expected 404 lookup produced one benign console error, not an app bug); manual SKU '725850327966' (seed_facts known-good SKU) -> navigated to /tag/88b0609e-5b74-47c7-a1f0-0d0021e4e3a0 with tag-price visible.

checks.criterion: Existing grid search + status filters still work
checks.name: finds-filters-and-legacy-inventory-route
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check unchanged: finds-search/filter chips/finds-grid all visible; gibberish query hides finds-grid; sold filter narrows to sold cards; legacy /inventory route still renders inventory-search.

checks.criterion: Typeahead suggestions on the Finds search box (public ingress sanity pass)
checks.name: quickfind-typeahead-preview-ingress
checks.evidence: Same typeahead flow run against https://thrift-vision.preview.emergentagent.com (the public preview ingress) instead of localhost: finds-suggestions rendered with >=1 option for 'jacket', confirming the proxy path works end to end.
